method: Read the original event bank, correlate the source actor action/animation or named projectile with this board’s actual action, then verify the exact clip exists in the installed Windows client. selectionLimits: No generic fallback was promoted to an original recording. Rows missing a verifiable original event stay out of the bank.
Source silent variants and indefinite loops need their original runtime scheduling. They remain unbound instead of being flattened into one generic hit.
Spell casts that share a board animation token require corroboration from the source actor ability, original animation and live board effect.
Actual game playback/recording QA is separate from this source-table and file verification.
